title: Logo Rules
description: A polished logo-system card showing approved lockups, compact use, and monochrome guidance.

defaultProps.title: Make recognition effortless
defaultProps.subtitle: The mark is the shortest path to recognition. Keep it clear, consistent, and unmistakably yours.

title: Clearspace Demo
description: A measured logo lockup demonstrates protected area and minimum clearspace with animated guides.

defaultProps.title: Give the mark room
defaultProps.subtitle: Clearspace keeps recognition intact when the context gets busy.

title: Dont Use Grid
description: A side-by-side do and don't grid makes logo misuse immediately legible for internal and client-facing guidance.

defaultProps.title: Protect the shape
defaultProps.subtitle: A good rule is easy to see: preserve the mark, its proportions, and its breathing room.

title: Color Do Dont
description: Approved color swatches and a deliberately noisy counterexample turn palette rules into a visual decision.

defaultProps.title: Color carries the signal
defaultProps.subtitle: Use contrast with intention, then let the system stay recognizable across every surface.

title: Type Rules
description: A living type specimen exposes display, title, body, and metadata roles in one compact hierarchy card.

defaultProps.title: One voice, many sizes
defaultProps.subtitle: A type system gives every message the right amount of emphasis.

title: Photography Rules
description: A paired imagery board contrasts a textured point of view with generic visual noise.

defaultProps.title: Show the point of view
defaultProps.subtitle: Choose imagery with texture, humanity, and enough room for the message to land.

title: Motion Rules
description: An animated timing curve turns restraint, reveal, and settle into a memorable motion principle.

defaultProps.title: Motion earns attention
defaultProps.subtitle: Use a clear entrance, one meaningful emphasis, and a calm landing.
notes: Motion earns attention; it does not demand it.

title: Icon Rules
description: A procedural icon grid communicates consistent stroke, optical weight, and one-idea-per-icon rules.

defaultProps.title: One stroke. One idea.
defaultProps.subtitle: Consistent icons make the system feel considered at every scale.
notes: Let icons breathe at every size.

title: Voice Card
description: A two-column voice card makes the brand's preferred tone and its anti-patterns easy to reuse.

defaultProps.title: Sound like a useful human
defaultProps.subtitle: Tone is a system too: clear, warm, direct, and never louder than the idea.

title: Guidelines Close
description: A cinematic closing card gathers the logo, core principles, and next-use prompts into one reusable lockup.

defaultProps.title: Build the recognizable thing
defaultProps.subtitle: A living system for every place the brand shows up.
